tasks.title: Generate and verify isolated paired-event fixtures
checks: Start only after independent architecture review, implementation authorization and a new frozen run

Test acoustic IDs against partial/post-seek capture, missing/duplicate/unknown pulses, offsets beyond one period and pitch-preserved/scaled 0.5x/1x/2x records; actual decoded combined/separate fixtures must pass the same ID decoder

Test rational event recipe, decoded onset validation, signed media-to-capture correction at 0.5x/1x/2x, interval uncertainty, unequal stream rates/drift, missing calibration/mapping, invalid destinations and bounded child cancellation
Explicitly generate in a new ignored output directory with verified tools; preserve old fixture identities

tasks.title: Prepare a bounded observation session and capture procedure
checks: Reuse the unchanged fixture server and supplied replacement app; verify candidate, runtime and new fixture identities
Test normal exit, interruption, expired deadline, failed spawn and server cleanup with controlled child processes; forced cleanup is failure

Document human audibility and the retained optional externally calibrated capture procedure (not an M1 or mandatory later gate under ADR 0006); do not start a recorder or assert physical results without authorized evidence

tasks.title: Record independent preparation review and any authorized observations
checks: Obtain separately authorized independent exact-candidate method/code review; author checks are not approval

Record physical sync/rate measurements as never performed, not-tested and outside M1 scope with no mandatory later check under ADR 0006; retain platform cells and distinguish preparation from physical evidence
Preserve first failures, raw observations, uncertainty and retained acceptance criteria; removed physical measurements do not become PASS; no M1 or production adapter decision
